tint: multiply ONLY neutral grey pixels (r == g == b): rgb * role / 255. Team colour (sashes, banners, capes, shields, chest bands) is drawn grey; orc skin, wood, stone, metal, gold, fire are coloured and drawn as is
scale: PNG is 12x the logical pixel; the RTS map uses 6x, so draw at 0.5x, nearest-neighbour only. HUD uses 4x (0.333x)
files: <name>/<state>_<i>.png, all frames of one object share size, anchor and top
generic_states: catch (squash-stretch) and flinch (shake) exist for every object
crowd: worker and warrior exist only in this mode: many copies on the map, they carry tokens (gold sack = value) or form the horde (load)
fixed_colour: parcel is a wooden crate: tint=false
